agent.description: The agent that reviews (Settings → AI → Agents). Its permissions must let it save drafts for what it finds: set Entries: author to Allow for it.

entry_type.description: The entries reviewed (published and changed in the last 7 days).

message.description: What to check for. The week's changed entries, and the reminder to write each note itself and save it with create_draft, are added for you.
message.example: Review them for typos, broken promises in the summary, and anything that breaks the house style.

timezone.description: The time zone the schedule runs in (IANA name).
